_doc: HL7 validator findings we accept, each with its reason. `match` is a substring of the message; `files` an optional glob; `severity` warning (default) or error. An `offline` entry applies only to the -tx n/a run: it covers a code the validator cannot resolve without a terminology server, and the nightly tx.fhir.org run must pass without it. Read by scripts/check_fhir_validator.py.

allow.reason: Best practice only. The document's narrative lives on the Composition sections; NRCeS does not require per-resource narrative, and its own examples get theirs from the IG publisher.

allow.match: all observations should have a performer
allow.reason: Best practice only. A lab result's performer is on its DiagnosticReport (the lab), which the NRCeS DiagnosticReportLab profile carries.
Base R4 binding (extensible). NRCeS replaces it with ndhm-claim-type (SNOMED), and NRCeS's own ClaimBundle examples use the same SNOMED code 737481003.
Base R4 binding (extensible). NRCeS types a claim number with its own ndhm-identifier-type-code CLN, which the NHCX IG defines for exactly this.
Offline run: UCUM and other codes are checked by the nightly tx.fhir.org run.

allow.match: Unable to check whether the code is in the value set
allow.reason: Offline run: SNOMED and LOINC value-set membership is checked by the nightly tx.fhir.org run.

allow.match: could not be found, so the code cannot be validated
allow.reason: Offline run: the SNOMED and LOINC code systems are not in the package cache.

allow.match: Unable to validate code without using server
allow.reason: Offline run: UCUM has no enumerated codes offline.

allow.match: None of the codings provided are in the value set
allow.reason: Offline run: with LOINC/SNOMED absent the validator cannot see that the codes are members; the nightly run checks them.

allow.match: was not found in the value set 'MimeType'
allow.reason: Offline run: urn:ietf:bcp:13 (MIME types) resolves only through a terminology server; application/pdf is checked nightly.
Offline run: as above, the MIME-type code system is not available offline.

allow.match: was not found in the value set 'CurrencyCode'
allow.reason: Offline run: urn:iso:std:iso:4217 (currencies) resolves only through a terminology server; INR is checked nightly.
Offline run: as above, the ISO 4217 code system is not available offline.

allow.match: Unable to find a match for profile
allow.reason: Offline run: the DocumentReference fails its profile only on the MIME code above; the slice match is re-checked nightly.

allow.match: Unable to find a match for profile
allow.reason: Offline run: the Invoice fails its profile only on the ISO 4217 code above; the slice match is re-checked nightly.
